Running a study

A study is a config file plus data. Point-and-click through the Shiny app or drive the same pipeline from YAML; both take the same route.

Is the gap between two model runs real?

load_config()
Load and validate a taupatch run config

The stages a run passes through, and how far along each one is

Run the full taupatch pipeline
run_taupatch_app()
Launch the taupatch Shiny app
save_config()
Write a config list to a YAML file
single_stages()
Individually resolved life stages

Zooplankton data

Reading plankton counts and getting them into one shape. A patch is defined by a species-and-stage abundance threshold, so which stages a column holds matters as much as the number in it.

The count and the unit a suffix encodes

Species a formatted database could model
